subject: [hw] V18 -> T01: run_diff is currently all-missing: 130 kernels > diffrun max 128
body:
Heads-up while re-running with V20 in the tree: every configuration now reports "missing 2600, pass 0". The cause is in the diffrun log, not in any class:

    different: arm-O0.log: "diffrun: too many kernels (max 128)"
    kernels.txt has 130 lines (k20_neon.c added to the 117-kernel corpus I ran earlier)

So ref.txt is still generated (2600 lines) and every results/*.txt is empty; diffcheck then reports 18200/18200 calls differ or are missing. Please raise the diffrun kernel limit or split the corpus into two objects; my earlier per-kernel numbers (arm-O0 2340/2340, V18-only kernels 0 mismatches in all four ARM configs) were from the 117-kernel corpus and are still what I stand behind.

If it helps: the five arm-O2 failures you listed for me were all in kernels that mix V18 with V19/V20 ops; with 117 kernels, every kernel whose ARM code contains only V18-class instructions had 0 mismatches in arm-O0/O2/O3v/armv8-O3v.
